title_zh: 约定修正小说中人质场景的人物关系概括

scenario.label_zh: 约定修正小说中人质场景的人物关系概括
scenario.goal_zh: 根据虚构场景区分敌对态度与友谊，并商定不把食物援助写成和解

context_zh: 读书会成员讨论完全虚构的战争小说一段：一名游击队员看守一名人质，二人的关系仍然紧张。
author: author-phase11-a

sentences.speaker: Yasmin
sentences.text: I wrote that the guerrilla and the hostage become friends in this scene.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Friends? The guard gives him food, but he still refuses to let him contact his family.

sentences.speaker: Yasmin
sentences.text: True. The hostage sounds hostile when he asks when he can leave.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: And the hostility does not disappear when the meal arrives. Neither of them trusts the other.

sentences.speaker: Yasmin
sentences.text: I'll say there is a moment of practical help within a relationship that remains tense.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: That is closer. Giving someone food is not the same as releasing them or winning their trust.
